commands.command: cargo clippy -- -D warnings -D unsafe_code -D clippy::unwrap_used -D clippy::expect_used -D clippy::panic -D clippy::panic_in_result_fn -D clippy::todo -D clippy::unimplemented -D clippy::dbg_macro -D clippy::indexing_slicing -D clippy::string_slice -D clippy::get_unwrap -D clippy::arithmetic_side_effects -D clippy::as_conversions -D clippy::let_underscore_must_use

rules_satisfied: No production unsafe, unwrap, expect, panic, todo, unimplemented, unreachable, or assert macros
Lossy `as` conversion replaced with u32::try_from with typed error mapping
Payload length check against max_payload before encoding
try_reserve before Vec growth with Allocation error mapping
No unchecked indexing, arithmetic, or lossy casts in production code
residual_risk: None. All Holzman constraints satisfied. The only production change was adding payload-size validation, replacing lossy as u32 with checked try_from, and adding try_reserve/checked_add for allocation safety.
